|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Tactical Recall (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Use 2 Force to deploy on opponent's site. Target opponent's leader at a site or character at the Senate. Character's game text is canceled. Effect lost when character reaches this site.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Use 2 Force to deploy on opponent’s site. Target opponent’s leader at a site or character at the Galactic Senate. Target’s game text is canceled. Utinni Effect canceled when reached by target.” '''What changed:''' “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; added “Galactic”; “Character's” → “Target’s”; added “Utinni”; “lost” → “canceled”; “character reaches this site.” → “reached by target.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 47. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Tactical Re-Call]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
|hatnote=Earlier versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Tactical Recall (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Tactical Re-Call]]. Code OVS2 · GEMP id 1102_47.
